name: FUEL_FOOD_TOILETS_DIAG_ARROW_BLUE_TALL

service_fuel.desc: Fuel pump service symbol, 800x800 box; drawn 656x635 ink centred in its 800x800 box (element box = ink extent, since the generator fits the symbol to its box).

service_food.desc: Crossed spoon and fork, 640x800 box; drawn 467x635 ink centred in its 640x800 box (element box = ink extent, since the generator fits the symbol to its box).

service_toilets.desc: Toilets symbol (female and male figures in two door panels), 800x800 box; drawn 656x634 ink centred in its 800x800 box (element box = ink extent, since the generator fits the symbol to its box).

arrow_diag_up_left_487.desc: Straight block arrow pointing up-left at 45 degrees, 487x487 box (146.5 grid): head 526 across, barbs 337, 261, notch 120, 41 offset, shaft 163 wide, R24 head and tail corners.

notes: 2120x2930 R240; blue 50 / white 50. 260 | 800 | 160 | 800 | 160 | 487 | 263 = 2930. Row 1: 260 | 800 | 160 | 640 | 260; toilets 660 | 800 | 660; arrow 816 | 487 | 817. Service symbols: the drawing dimensions the symbol boxes (service_fuel 800x800 at 260,260; service_food 640x800 at 1220,260; service_toilets 800x800 at 660,1220); the pictograms do not fill them, so each element box is the pictogram's ink extent measured from the drawing, centred in the dimensioned box (nominal_box).
